title: The data of cycle.ended
description: A cycle's history line is written. Witness: the work line in tehas history --json. Version 1 of the events. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed; a minor release may add an optional field. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

cycle.description: The cycle id, <blueprint>-<attempt>, unique within one store.

blueprint.description: The blueprint, the factory API's issue.

ticket.description: The ticket, in the ports' shape. Left out when it is the blueprint.

ended.description: When it ended; for a lost cycle, when it was last heard from.

recorded.description: When a line written later than ended was written.

end.description: The end word, from a closed set: a new word is a major change.

outcome.description: History's outcome, the store's status word.

signalled.description: A signal stopped it. Left out when false.
